verdict.rationale: Sentry ships an official, scriptable sentry-cli. It installs as a single-file executable on Linux, macOS and Windows and can authenticate non-interactively with Organization Tokens. It automates pipeline tasks such as creating releases, uploading artifacts and debug files, sending events and uploading snapshots for GitHub status checks, all typical CI steps. However, the evidence never explicitly documents a headless or CI mode or a CI integration guide, so coverage is partial rather than complete. Missing for 10: explicit CI/headless usage documentation (e.g. env-var token configuration, CI pipeline examples), non-interactive operation guarantees, independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
